acip: 'DOD NA, DON BYED NUS PA CHOS CAN, KHYOD MTSON BYA YIN PAR THAL, KHYOD MTSON BYA YIN KHYOD MTSON BYA DANG BDAG GCIG TU 'BREL, KHYOD MA YIN ZHING MTSON BYA YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA DU MA GRUB PA'I PHYIR,

english: Then yes, I agree: it is the case that the ability to perform a function is (1) something to be defined; and that (2) it has a relationship to things to be defined such that to be it is to be something to be defined; and that (3) there are many examples of things which are not the ability to perform a function, but which are still things to be defined. Suppose you do agree. Let's consider then this ability to perform a function. It must then be something which is defined, Because, according to you, it is the case that the ability to perform a function is (1) something to be defined; and that (2) it has a relationship to things to be defined such that to be it is to be something to be defined; and that (3) there are many examples of things which are not the ability to perform a function, but which are still things to be defined.
